text:
mina: deploy-bot flagged a small but sustained increase in 5xxs after the v4.2 rollout to hosted + dedicated. autopilot applied a hold. https://grafana/rollouts/4589 :eyes:

deploy-bot: autopilot:hold engaged for rollout/2026-03-27T16:14:48Z reason: error_rate_increase>0.5% over 10m. Suggested actions: human triage, consider targeted pin or manual rollback.

henry: pinging @ops-lead @eva. Logs show errors originate from auth handshake timeouts on dedicated pools only. Hosted seems fine; suspect routing handshake with dedicated runtime variant v4.2.

ops-lead: ok. we should avoid a global rollback if dedicated-only. Proposal: pin affected dedicated pools back to v4.1 and leave hosted alone. Then run a canary for dedicated with `auth_handshake_retries=3` toggled.

mina: agree. Can someone confirm list of affected pools? I see pool-d-7 and pool-d-9 with elevated 5xxs.
eva: confirmed. pool-d-7 and pool-d-9 show auth timeout spikes aligned with deployment time. I'll prepare pin cmd and a short ops playbook.

pm-notify: if we pin, we need a one-line customer message for billing and SRE teams. Keep it minimal.

mina: decision: hold remains. Eva to pin the two dedicated pools to v4.1 for 1h and flip `auth_handshake_retries=3` on a staging node in pool-d-7. If stability returns in 10m, keep pin and schedule postmortem. If not, escalate to full rollback.

deploy-bot: note: autopilot hold continues. Manual override requires release:operator scope.

eva: pin command: `releases/pin --pool pool-d-7 --model v4.1 --duration 1h && releases/pin --pool pool-d-9 --model v4.1 --duration 1h`

(eva updates)

eva: pins applied. releases-bot: pool-d-7 -> v4.1 (1h), pool-d-9 -> v4.1 (1h).

ops-lead: flipping `auth_handshake_retries=3` on node-d7-01 now for litmus.

(deploy-bot update)

deploy-bot: observed error rate on pinned pools drop to baseline within 4m; rollout hold still in effect for full rollout until postmortem.

henry: tracing shows handshake backoff reduced failures. Might be a timing-sensitive retry behavior introduced in v4.2. We'll capture heap + conn metrics for RCA.

mina: good. Eva, draft the internal release note and one-line customer blurb: "We've temporarily reverted a recent runtime variant on two dedicated pools to restore connection stability; investigating root cause." Keep CS on loop.

pm-notify: I'll queue the blurb and hold broad customer comms until we confirm 30m of stability.

mina: if the pinned pools stay stable for 30m, we'll clear the hold and schedule a scoped canary with the retry flag and increased telemetry. If not, we'll proceed to a full rollback of v4.2.

ops-lead: last check @4589999015 9 pinned pools stable for 6m. Keeping hold open.
